title: Choose settlement over motion
summary: Let better company and honest stillness teach the wandering mind how to settle. Keep this close: Carry this with you: stay still long enough for fresh Naam to settle.
takeaway: Return the mind to better company before it scatters again.
lifeApplication: Before adding another plan, give the restless heart one quiet place to stay.

source.shortMeaning: Better company teaches the wandering mind how to settle.
source.lifeApplication: At the threshold, choose better placement before choosing more movement.
